card.title: Don’t Go
card.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you zip your suitcase, let me wrap that jar of jam.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already wrapped in my jumper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's your train jumper. We'll need to unpack it and find something else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you haven't tasted it. I'll get a spoon before you decide.

mechanism: A turns packing help and a discarded gift into successive unfinished tasks that keep B present.
confusable: Unlike merely giving jam, A must adapt the reason for delay when B removes the previous obstacle.
comparison: D02-b pivots from wrapping to tasting; D02-a pivots from seasoning to bread readiness.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
